call_purpose: Some of your students told you that the lesson videos in your course keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on a desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone; the video played fine each time, so we could not reproduce the problem. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one of your students to make a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our team and get back to you; we are not able to give a timeline yet.
